_purpose: §69 v3.1 최종 정상 데이터 수집 계획 - docs/design/phase8-blue-green-preflight-incident.md §69와 동일 내용, 기계 판독용. official_collection_manifest.json(§65)/official_collection_manifest_v2.json(§67)은 종료된 사전등록 이력으로 그대로 보존하고 수정하지 않는다 - 이 파일이 현재 유효한 계획다.
scope: data collection and quality audit only - no model training, no threshold determination

burst_also_permanently_excluded.reason: official-calib-burst-20260920 produced a genuine 30s-sustained SLO violation (t_slo not null) on the 3rd independent burst attempt, even though qualification and official-train-burst both passed - reproducibility not established (2 pass / 1 fail out of 3)
burst_also_permanently_excluded.action: removed from final normal-data candidate regimes, same treatment as sustained_load - PASS sessions are not cherry-picked as normal data

idle.load: none beyond the SLO probe (no ramp pod created)

section_58_idle_assignment_also_supersed: windows.ACTIVE_PLUS_PREVIEW_SESSIONS idle role assignment from §65.2 is superseded by freshly-measured 600s idle sessions in v3.1 - not reused, preserved as part of the concluded §65 plan
session_procedure: run assigned profile (idle: probe only, no ramp pod; low_load: run_candidate 0.025 RPS 600s)
valid_session_conditions: t_slo == null (covers both 30s-sustained latency violation and immediate availability violation)
no missing/NaN/stale on any of the 8 feature source metrics (zero invalid windows)
feature window timestamps fall within session boundaries (window_boundary_ok)
cfs_throttle_policy: recorded, not a session-exclusion criterion on its own

failure_and_rerun_rules.real_slo_violation_in_idle_or_low_load: stop remaining collection immediately, do not adjust intensity/session length, do not delete the SLO-violating session, do not run a substitute session
failure_and_rerun_rules.restart_oom_node_promotion_cleanup_failu: stop immediately, same as an SLO violation
failure_and_rerun_rules.technical_harness_error: preserve raw data, record with exact reason, fix code + pass offline tests, rerun from scratch under a NEW session_id

items: session and row counts per split/regime
regime distribution in train and calibration
independent session count reported separately from overlapping row count
difference between expected 222 rows and actual row count

boundary_challenge_set.scoring_policy: score exactly once, only after model and threshold are fully frozen; exploratory only (false-detection-on-safe-transient check, detection-on-real-violation check, lead-time check); never used for threshold tuning

scope_limits: no holdout or boundary-challenge anomaly score computation

tooling.script: anomaly-detection/v3/qualify_normal_profile.py (extended with --v31 --split-role; new run_idle_session() for the idle regime, no other new cluster-mutating code)
